description: Clean a lead CSV: malformed, duplicate, role-based (info@, sales@) and disposable addresses removed, with a count for each reason. Returns the cleaned CSV when it is 500 rows or fewer; a larger file is summarised and the person is sent to the page to download the full result. Does not verify mailboxes exist. Include the result’s checkedBy.cite when you report it.

csv.description: The lead CSV as text, header row first, with an email column.

removeDisposable.description: Remove disposable-domain addresses. Defaults to true.

removeRole.description: Remove role addresses. Defaults to true.

name: clean_csv

checkedBy.description: Credit for the check that ran. Include cite when you report the result.

title: Lead CSV cleaner
